action_items: No blocking issues. Focus feature (extra_time_requests) works end-to-end including persistence.

OPTIONAL polish: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx addDevice() still shows web-hostile Alert.alert on error paths; consider keeping the inline pairing-error style also for extra_time_requests failures (createRequest / toggleBlock / decideRequest use Alert.alert).
OPTIONAL refactor: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx keeps 7 components on very long single lines (~90 lines of dense code) — split into per-component files for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx line 61 chains many awaits; usage (device_sessions) and requests fetch errors are silently swallowed (u.error and r.error are not surfaced). Non-blocking today because tables are healthy, but should be handled for defensive UX.

index.tsx line 68 realtime subscribes to extra_time_requests globally (no family filter). Fine for a small demo, but every parent will receive events for other families' rows; consider filtering client-side by device_id ∈ family devices before calling load(true).

index.tsx toggleBlock / decideRequest / createRequest use Alert.alert on error which is not modal on web. Inline error state (as already done for pairing-error) is more reliable feedback in the Expo web preview.
index.tsx signup path does not auto-sign-in when Supabase's 'Confirm email' is off — user must manually switch to login mode. Minor UX bump.
